title: Captive crank and guided frame
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (cycle) over a complete turn. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The captive pin sweeps both horizontal extremes each turn. The yoke stays on its horizontal guide. A positive, B positive. The requested motion is horizontal reciprocation (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.
